notes.title: 🧸 Cozy Job Simulator – September 13–27, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hey Cozy Crew! 🎉[/p][p]We’re beyond excited to announce that [b]Cozy Job Simulator[/b] is coming to Steam for a special two‑week celebration from [b]September 13 to 27, 2025[/b]! This is your chance to step into a world where work feels like play, and every shift is a chance to relax, explore, and create your own cozy story.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re here for the [b]soothing visuals[/b], the [b]gentle gameplay[/b], or the [b]joy of discovering something new[/b], there’s a place for you in the Cozy Crew. From now until [b]Sept 27[/b], step into a world where work feels like play. Relax, explore, and craft your own cozy story with the Cozy Crew. 💼✨[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dive into the full Cozy Job Simulators showcase ▶️ [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45686865/sale/CozyJobSimulators"]Click here[/url][b]
[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/dRO7QmQ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482510/Packing_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Our Kickstarter is Coming Soon, Stay Notified!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’re super excited to announce that our [b]Kickstarter campaign is launching very soon[/b]!
If you've been following our game and want to support us, now’s the perfect time to jump in.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/arokogamestudio/packing-life"]Click here,[/url] then tap “Notify me on launch” to be first in line when we go live.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]What to expect from our Kickstarter:
🧳 A cozy and satisfying puzzle game filled with warmth, clever mechanics, and relaxing vibes
🎁 Wonderful rewards that make you feel like a true part of the game’s journey
📦 A chance to shape the future of the game with your feedback and ideas[/p][p][/p][p]Your support during the [b]first 24 hours[/b] makes a huge difference, it helps us reach more players and build a stronger community.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/dRO7QmQ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482510/Packing_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Soundtrack Incoming!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,  
We’ve got exciting news to share, Packing Life is teaming up with an incredibly talented indie composer to create a truly unique musical experience for the game! 🎶[/p][p][/p][p] [b][i][u]This is where the Packing Life soundtracks comes to life.[/u][/i][/b] [/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FwqBqEx.jpg"][/img]
Expect fresh, heartfelt melodies that enhance the vibe and bring even more depth to your journey. These soundtracks aren't just background music, they're part of the story.[/p][p]Stay tuned for behind-the-scenes insights and an exclusive preview of the new tracks, coming soon to our social channels.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/dRO7QmQ.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482510/Packing_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Packing Life — Steam Page Now Live!
notes.content:
[p][b]We’re excited to officially announce Packing Life![/b]
Our cozy puzzle-simulation game is now visible on Steam, and we can’t wait for you to see it.[/p][p][/p][p]This moment marks a meaningful new chapter for us at Aroko Game Studio. It’s our first publicly revealed title in a year full of ambitious plans, and it reflects who we’re becoming: a studio that values emotion, precision, and thoughtful innovation. Your support means the world to us—it helps our studio grow and share even more heartfelt experiences with players around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist's our new title and introduce us to your friends  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/dRO7QmQ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482510/Packing_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
